QLabel.name: maintenance_intro
QLabel.text: These actions affect Windows display-driver state and cached display configuration. Use them after installing or removing overrides, or if Windows needs to redetect displays.

QPushButton.name: reset_selected_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Removes the EDID override for the selected display from Windows.

QPushButton.name: reset_all_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Clears all display overrides and display-driver cache entries. Active EDID is preserved.

QPushButton.name: restart_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Disables and re-enables display adapters so Windows redetects displays.

QPushButton.name: recovery_restart_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Temporarily stages override recovery data, restarts the driver, then restores overrides.
